checks: AI routes enforce authentication and separate platform, enterprise-admin and sales roles
AI starts disabled with no hidden model or secret
Unconfigured AI records BLOCKED without outbound calls or budget charges
Platform model settings validate prices, duplicates and optimistic versions
Provider credentials never appear in platform responses
Tenant admins configure bounded model, budget and rate settings
Confirmation preview redacts free-text contact details and credentials
Sending requires approval and a content-bound confirmation token
Successful call records reported usage and redacts model output
Retries reuse one result while confirmation tokens remain single use
Changed settings and expired confirmations prevent outbound requests
Concurrent duplicate submissions invoke the supplier once
Definitive supplier rejection releases reserved tokens and reference cost
Ambiguous supplier failure retains conservative usage without retry
Missing supplier usage is charged at the reserved upper bound
Insufficient token budget blocks before any supplier call
Insufficient reference-cost budget also blocks before dispatch
Platform model changes invalidate previously approved sends
Feedback is attached to authorized records and redacts notes
Enterprise policy and usage stay isolated
AI history cannot cross enterprise boundaries
Revoked record access also removes historical AI results and feedback access
Expired enterprises cannot preview or initiate paid AI requests
AI policy and usage tables enforce forced tenant RLS
Supplier payloads contain neither tools nor plaintext contact details
Every dispatch records an auditable terminal outcome
